title: Merged-PR-linked Hermitian-symmetry witness for NeuralOperator SpectralConv

source_case_schema.subject_program: NeuralOperator SpectralConv real-valued inverse FFT path
source_case_schema.source_function: small complex frequency vector before the final irfft stage

parameters.real_signal_constraint: DC and Nyquist frequencies must be real before irfft
parameters.corrective_action: zero imaginary parts at boundary frequencies

transformation_preconditions: The subject is a real-valued inverse FFT path.
The post-partial-IFFT spectrum exposes DC and Nyquist frequencies.
The spatial size is even when a Nyquist frequency is present.
The external merged PR documents Hermitian-symmetry enforcement before irfft.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: NeuralOperator PR #702 adds an enforce_hermitian_symmetry flag and explicitly zeroes imaginary parts of the 0th and Nyquist frequencies before irfft.

output_mapping.description: Compare boundary-frequency imaginary parts before and after the PR-linked Hermitian-symmetry enforcement.

metric.name: irfft_boundary_frequency_imaginary_part
metric.formula: max(abs(imag(dc)), abs(imag(nyquist))) before and after enforcement

exclusion_rules: Exclude claims that the witness reproduces GPU-specific line artifacts on the local machine.
Exclude claims about trained NeuralOperator or FNO accuracy.
Exclude claims about all FFT paths or all spectral layers.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The PR artifact is present and the witness reproduces the added Hermitian-symmetry enforcement semantics.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The artifact checks or frequency-boundary metrics contradict the PR-linked correction.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because source artifacts were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The target path is not a real-valued irfft path or exposes no DC/Nyquist constraints.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: Floating-point tolerance dominates the boundary imaginary-part metric.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The external PR link or semantic witness evidence is incomplete.

claim_limitations: This MR card supports one external merged-PR-linked Hermitian-symmetry semantic witness for NeuralOperator SpectralConv. It does not reproduce GPU-specific line artifacts, validate trained-FNO accuracy, establish NeuralOperator-wide correctness, or report a real-world defect-detection rate.
